spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (गहयति)
To be thick or impervious as a forest, &c.

m. (-हः)
1 A cave.
2 A forest.
E.
गह to be impervious, अच् aff.

(ऊ) गाहू r. 1st cl. (गाहते)
1 To churn, to stir or agitate.
2 To penetrate.
3 To destroy.
With अव or वि prefixed,
To bathe, to perform ablutions.
With वि,
To shake, to agitate.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Impervious, inaccessible.
n. (-नं)
1 A wood, a thicket.
2 A cave.
3 Pain, distress.
E.
गाह to tremble, &c. affix युच्, and the radical vowel made short; or गह to be thick, affix as before.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating to a cave or a thicket, deep, difficult of access, impervious.
E.
गह a thicket, छ^1 aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

nf. (-रं-री)
A cave, a cavern, a grotto, a recess in a rock or mountain, &c.
n. (-रं)
1 A thicket, a wood.
2

Weeping, crying, but not violently.
m. (-रः)
An arbour, a bower.
E.
गाह to be agitated, and ष्वरच् Uṇādi affix, the radical vowel made short.

Plunged into, immersed.
E.
गाह to agitate, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
1 Shaking, agitating.
2 Destroying, a destroyer.
3 One who plunges into water, bathes, dives, &c.
E.
गाह to agitate, तृच् aff.
